column1: # Every way the JIT tier may decline to run Wasm code compiled, by opcode.
# kind is `refusal` (the function is not compiled because it contains the
# opcode; ffff is a refusal of the whole function), `exit` (compiled code
# leaves to the interpreter at the opcode), or `retirement` (opcode `-`: a
# function retired by its exit rate; each exit behind it has its own row).
# The spec-suite gate fails on any refusal or exit that has no row here, and
# each rule is documented in documentation/design.md.
